## Overview

**Lord Alaric Arkwright** — a paladin of noble descent from the families that rule the Last Stand. He was the leader of the seven Alliance heroes selected to defeat Khar'Zul, and it was his leadership that kept the entire force together even as the battle descended into chaos.

---

## Role in the Alliance

Lord Alaric was the paladin leader of the party entrusted with bringing down Khar'Zul. He was of noble descent from the families that rule the Last Stand.

---

## Fate

Lord Alaric survived both battles against Khar'Zul and the sealing ritual.
